translations.web: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.
translations.bsb: Sorrow is better than laughter, for a sad countenance is good for the heart.
translations.kjv: Sorrow is better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better.
translations.asv: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made glad.
